recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 中央為上皮樣組織球與多核巨細胞圍繞一團亮紅色、呈結晶狀至無定形的嗜酸性物質，外圍為小淋巴球，屬 Kimura 病中可見的肉芽腫反應。
features: Central aggregate of bright eosinophilic crystal-like to amorphous material
Surrounding palisade of epithelioid histiocytes with oval vesicular nuclei
Multinucleated giant cells at the edge of the eosinophilic material
Outer rim of small mature lymphocytes and scattered plasma cells
No necrotizing caseation or atypical large cells in this field
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a granuloma composed of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells surrounding a central aggregate of bright eosinophilic, crystal-like to amorphous material. The granuloma is surrounded by small mature lymphocytes and scattered plasma cells, without caseous necrosis or atypical cells in this field. The eosinophilic material is suggestive of degranulated eosinophil products such as Charcot-Leyden crystals. In the context of eosinophilic microabscesses and follicular changes elsewhere, the findings are consistent with Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas often show caseous necrosis with organisms on AFB/GMS stains rather than eosinophilic crystalline debris.
Parasitic infection may show eosinophil-rich granulomas but contains identifiable parasite fragments with a matching exposure history.
LCH shows sinusoidal grooved Langerhans cells that are CD1a/langerin positive with eosinophils, rather than epithelioid granulomas.
EGPA shows necrotizing vasculitis with extravascular granulomas, asthma and ANCA positivity rather than node-restricted follicular hyperplasia.
